remarks: Make sure to check out this impressive & spacious Getzville 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath home located in the desirable Williamsville School District! Upscale renovations throughout! Large eat-in kitchen features beautiful maple cabinets, granite countertops, tiled backsplash, JennAir stainless steel appliances, gas cooktop with grill & downdraft feature, double convection oven, built-in dishwasher, tiled floors & skylights! Kitchen offers direct access to the large covered & open back deck with grapevines, perfect for outdoor dining & entertaining! Huge great room adjacent to kitchen features newer hardwood floors, gas fireplace insert & beautiful views of the backyard! Spacious living room & formal dining room offer cathedral ceilings & Pergo floors! Entire second floor features newly installed hardwood floors! Massive primary suite includes walk-in closet, additional closet space & beautifully updated custom bath featuring dual vanity, upscale fixtures, large tiled shower, Jacuzzi tub with tiled surround & porcelain floors! Additional full bath features comfort-height granite top vanity, tiled tub/shower & large linen closet! Two additional bedrooms are bright, spacious & offer ample closet space! Attached 2.5 car garage provides plenty of room for parking & storage! Additional updates include NEW hot water tank, sump pump with water backup & NYSERDA weatherization testing completed! Spray foam insulation added in the basement & attic, along with an attic fan to help improve the home's energy efficiency! Beautiful backyard with covered & open deck offers plenty of space to relax or entertain! Convenient location close to shopping, dining & everything Williamsville has to offer! Move-in ready & a must see!
